result.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: `record_for_host` queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` with `host = uri.host` (line 'host = uri.host' then the query). `uri.host` preserves the case as typed by the referer (e.g. 'EvilTrout.com'), while `lower(host)` downcases the stored value, so a capitalized referer host never matches. Also, the model validation regex allows an optional port `(:[0-9]{1,5})?` and before_validation strips only scheme and path (leaving ports in the stored host), but `uri.host` excludes the port, so a port-stored host can never match. Both mechanisms are grounded in diff lines.
